new_page.description: Edmonds, Burnaby condos for sale: 85 condos and townhomes listed in October 2026, monthly sales and how Edmonds compares with Burnaby. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®.
new_page.h1: Edmonds Condos for Sale | Burnaby Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Edmonds. No building list, strata fees, street boundaries or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Edmonds condos and townhomes in Burnaby: 85 listed at the end of October 2026 and 10 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. That makes Edmonds number 3 of 35 Burnaby communities by condo and townhome listings. Houses in Edmonds have their own page; this page is only about attached homes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo and townhome listings in Edmonds fell from 101 in June to 85 in October (−15.8%), while 63 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 6.5% of Burnaby’s 1,309 condo and townhome listings.
Edmonds also had 10 houses listed and 0 sold in October, against 85 condos and townhomes listed. If you are weighing a house, the Edmonds homes page has the detached figures and the feed for houses.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Edmonds?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 85 condos and townhomes listed in Edmonds. That is a month-end count and moves daily; ask Jared for what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Edmonds a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Edmonds had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos sold in Edmonds from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 63 condos and townhomes sold in Edmonds over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so any count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
